title: Wolfenstein 3 Release Date: Game Now In Production
description: No Wolfenstein 3 release date yet, but Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirms the game is in production at MachineGames, with motion capture already underway.

body.text: There is no Wolfenstein 3 release date yet, but the game is now officially real. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has confirmed that MachineGames has Wolfenstein 3 in production, according to Kotaku. It matters because the franchise has been quiet for roughly a decade since its last mainline entry, and Microsoft has cancelled several other projects recently.
Wolfenstein 3 release date: what we know

Sharma revealed the news by posting a photo of the game's script on her social media pages. She said she is looking forward to sharing more. The image itself says little, apart from showing that the first chapter is called "Nazitraz."

No release date, platforms or trailer have been shared. Kotaku points out that a script page and motion-capture suits are not much to go on, and that Xbox games are known for long gaps between reveal and release. In other words, do not expect it soon.

MachineGames followed Sharma's post with one of its own. It showed Brian Bloom and Debra Wilson filming a scene for the game, which confirms their return as BJ Blazkowicz and Grace Walker. Motion capture is therefore already underway.
Rumours of a third game had been circulating for some time, and Kotaku says it corroborated them earlier this year. This is the first official word.
Kotaku notes that the reveal arrives alongside a run of social media announcements for Halo and id Software, as the Xbox stable of studios shares new updates and projects.

There is also the wider franchise picture. Amazon announced last year that it is developing a TV series based on the rebooted Wolfenstein timeline. MachineGames also recently made an Indiana Jones game, and Kotaku says it let players punch even more Nazis in that one.
Kotaku adds that the series stands out for being openly critical of modern-day parallels to Nazism while still being fun to play.

The next things to look for are a proper reveal, platform details and a release window. Sharma's "looking forward to sharing more" suggests more is coming, though nothing has been confirmed. Until then, treat the project as early. It is in production, but only at the stage where the script is done and the actors are filming.

faqs.a: Yes. According to Kotaku, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at MachineGames by posting a photo of the game's script.
